# Repeated-measures ANOVA for between-group main effect
# Design: 2 groups, 3 repeated measurements per participant
# Compound symmetry covariance structure

# Study parameters
k <- 3  # number of repeated measurements
rho <- 0.5  # compound symmetry correlation
sigma <- 2.5  # marginal SD (both groups)
mu1 <- 51  # group 1 mean
mu2 <- 49  # group 2 mean
effect_size_raw <- mu1 - mu2  # raw difference in group means
alpha <- 0.05  # significance level, two-sided
target_power <- 0.80
allocation_ratio <- 1  # balanced groups

# Calculate the variance of the subject-level average
# Under compound symmetry: V_avg = σ²/k × [1 + (k-1)ρ]
var_avg <- (sigma^2 / k) * (1 + (k - 1) * rho)
sd_avg <- sqrt(var_avg)

cat("=== Repeated-Measures ANOVA Design Parameters ===\n")
cat("Number of repeated measurements (k):", k, "\n")
cat("Compound symmetry correlation (ρ):", rho, "\n")
cat("Marginal SD (σ):", sigma, "\n")
cat("Group 1 mean:", mu1, "\n")
cat("Group 2 mean:", mu2, "\n")
cat("Raw effect (Δ = μ₁ - μ₂):", effect_size_raw, "\n\n")

cat("=== Effective Variance of Subject-Level Average ===\n")
cat("Formula: V_avg = σ²/k × [1 + (k-1)ρ]\n")
cat("V_avg = (2.5)²/3 × [1 + 2(0.5)]\n")
cat("V_avg = 6.25/3 × 2\n")
cat("V_avg =", var_avg, "\n")
cat("SD_avg =", sd_avg, "\n\n")

# Effect size (Cohen's d) on averaged responses
cohens_d <- effect_size_raw / sd_avg

cat("=== Effect Size ===\n")
cat("Cohen's d (on averaged responses) = Δ / SD_avg\n")
cat("Cohen's d =", effect_size_raw, "/", round(sd_avg, 4), "=", round(cohens_d, 4), "\n\n")

# For a two-sample t-test (equivalent to between-group F-test)
# n_total = 2 * n_per_group (balanced design)
# SE(Δ) = sqrt(2 * V_avg / n_per_group)
# Under H1: t = Δ / SE(Δ) = sqrt(n_per_group * Δ² / (2 * V_avg))
# Power = P(t > t_crit | H1)

# Critical value for two-sided test at α=0.05
alpha_two_sided <- alpha / 2
z_crit <- qnorm(1 - alpha_two_sided)  # approximation for large df

cat("=== Test Statistics (Two-Sample t-test on Subject Averages) ===\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "(two-sided)\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("Z-critical (large df approximation):", round(z_crit, 4), "\n\n")

# Function to calculate power given n per group
calculate_power <- function(n_per_group) {
  df <- 2 * n_per_group - 2
  t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha_two_sided, df)
  
  # Non-centrality parameter: λ = sqrt(n_per_group / (2 * V_avg)) * Δ
  # Or equivalently: λ = sqrt(n_per_group * Δ² / (2 * V_avg))
  lambda <- sqrt(n_per_group * (effect_size_raw^2) / (2 * var_avg))
  
  # Power = P(t > t_crit | H1)
  power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = lambda)
  
  return(list(n = n_per_group, df = df, t_crit = t_crit, lambda = lambda, power = power))
}

# Search for minimum n achieving 80% power
# Start with a reasonable range
cat("=== Sample Size Determination ===\n")
cat("Searching for minimum n per group achieving 80% power...\n\n")

# Test a range of values
n_values <- seq(5, 30, by = 1)
results_df <- data.frame(
  n_per_group = n_values,
  df = NA,
  t_crit = NA,
  lambda = NA,
  power = NA
)

for (i in seq_along(n_values)) {
  res <- calculate_power(n_values[i])
  results_df$df[i] <- res$df
  results_df$t_crit[i] <- res$t_crit
  results_df$lambda[i] <- res$lambda
  results_df$power[i] <- res$power
}

# Display results
print(results_df, digits = 4)

# Find minimum n achieving target power
min_n <- min(which(results_df$power >= target_power))
n_min <- results_df$n_per_group[min_n]

cat("\n=== RESULTS ===\n")
cat("Minimum participants per group achieving 80% power:", n_min, "\n")
cat("Achieved power at n =", n_min, ":", round(results_df$power[min_n], 4), "\n")

# Also report the power at n_min - 1 to show it doesn't meet target
if (n_min > 1) {
  cat("Power at n =", n_min - 1, ":", 
      round(results_df$power[results_df$n_per_group == n_min - 1], 4), "\n")
}

# Store final answer
final_answer_n <- n_min
final_answer_power <- results_df$power[min_n]
final_answer_power_prev <- if (n_min > 1) results_df$power[results_df$n_per_group == n_min - 1] else NA

cat("\n=== Design Summary ===\n")
cat("Total participants: ", 2 * final_answer_n, "\n")
cat("Participants per group: ", final_answer_n, "\n")
cat("Repeated measurements per participant: ", k, "\n")
cat("Total observations: ", 2 * final_answer_n * k, "\n")

# Output for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
POWER_AGENT_RESULT <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = final_answer_n, unit = "participants_per_group"),
    list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(final_answer_power, 4), unit = "proportion"),
    list(metric = "power_at_n_minus_1", value = round(final_answer_power_prev, 4), unit = "proportion"),
    list(metric = "effect_size_cohens_d", value = round(cohens_d, 4), unit = "standardized"),
    list(metric = "effective_variance_avg", value = round(var_avg, 4), unit = "scale_units_squared")
  )
)

cat("\n")
print(POWER_AGENT_RESULT)

# Using a Monte Carlo simulation approach as an independent check

set.seed(42)
library(MASS)

# Design parameters
k <- 3  # repeated measurements
rho <- 0.5  # compound symmetry correlation
sigma <- 2.5  # marginal SD
mu1 <- 51  # group 1 mean
mu2 <- 49  # group 2 mean
effect_raw <- mu1 - mu2
alpha <- 0.05
n_per_group <- 18  # candidate answer

# Build compound symmetry covariance matrix
# Cov(Y_i, Y_j) = sigma^2 if i=j, sigma^2 * rho otherwise
Sigma_cs <- sigma^2 * (diag(k) * (1 - rho) + matrix(rho, k, k))

cat("=== Independent Verification via Simulation ===\n")
cat("Compound Symmetry Covariance Matrix:\n")
print(round(Sigma_cs, 4))
cat("\n")

# Run Monte Carlo simulation
n_sims <- 10000
sim_rejections <- 0
sim_test_stats <- numeric(n_sims)
sim_group1_avgs <- numeric(n_sims)
sim_group2_avgs <- numeric(n_sims)

for (sim in 1:n_sims) {
  # Generate data for group 1
  Y1 <- mvrnorm(n_per_group, mu = rep(mu1, k), Sigma = Sigma_cs)
  Y1_avg <- rowMeans(Y1)
  
  # Generate data for group 2
  Y2 <- mvrnorm(n_per_group, mu = rep(mu2, k), Sigma = Sigma_cs)
  Y2_avg <- rowMeans(Y2)
  
  # Two-sample t-test on averages
  t_stat <- t.test(Y1_avg, Y2_avg, var.equal = TRUE)$statistic
  p_val <- t.test(Y1_avg, Y2_avg, var.equal = TRUE)$p.value
  
  sim_test_stats[sim] <- t_stat
  sim_group1_avgs[sim] <- mean(Y1_avg)
  sim_group2_avgs[sim] <- mean(Y2_avg)
  
  # Count rejections (two-sided test at alpha=0.05)
  if (p_val < alpha) {
    sim_rejections <- sim_rejections + 1
  }
}

simulated_power_se <- sqrt(simulated_power * (1 - simulated_power) / n_sims)

cat("Sample size per group: n =", n_per_group, "\n")

cat("95% CI: [", round(simulated_power - 1.96*simulated_power_se, 4), ", ",

cat("1. Test Calibration Under Null Hypothesis (H₀: μ₁ = μ₂)\n")
cat("   Generating data under null (both groups mean = 50)\n\n")

rejections_null <- 0

  Y1 <- mvrnorm(n_per_group, mu = rep(50, k), Sigma = Sigma_cs)
  Y2 <- mvrnorm(n_per_group, mu = rep(50, k), Sigma = Sigma_cs)
  Y1_avg <- rowMeans(Y1)
  Y2_avg <- rowMeans(Y2)
  
  t_test <- t.test(Y1_avg, Y2_avg, var.equal = TRUE)
  if (t_test$p.value < alpha) {
    rejections_null <- rejections_null + 1
  }
}

type_i_error <- rejections_null / n_sims_null
type_i_se <- sqrt(type_i_error * (1 - type_i_error) / n_sims_null)

cat("Expected α = 0.0500\n")

# Repeated-measures ANOVA for between-group main effect
# Design: 2 groups, 3 repeated measurements per participant
# Compound symmetry covariance structure

# Study parameters
k <- 3  # number of repeated measurements
rho <- 0.5  # compound symmetry correlation
sigma <- 2.5  # marginal SD (both groups)
mu1 <- 51  # group 1 mean
mu2 <- 49  # group 2 mean
effect_size_raw <- mu1 - mu2  # raw difference in group means
alpha <- 0.05  # significance level, two-sided
target_power <- 0.80
allocation_ratio <- 1  # balanced groups

# Calculate the variance of the subject-level average
# Under compound symmetry: V_avg = σ²/k × [1 + (k-1)ρ]
var_avg <- (sigma^2 / k) * (1 + (k - 1) * rho)
sd_avg <- sqrt(var_avg)

cat("=== Repeated-Measures ANOVA Design Parameters ===\n")
cat("Number of repeated measurements (k):", k, "\n")
cat("Compound symmetry correlation (ρ):", rho, "\n")
cat("Marginal SD (σ):", sigma, "\n")
cat("Group 1 mean:", mu1, "\n")
cat("Group 2 mean:", mu2, "\n")
cat("Raw effect (Δ = μ₁ - μ₂):", effect_size_raw, "\n\n")

cat("=== Effective Variance of Subject-Level Average ===\n")
cat("Formula: V_avg = σ²/k × [1 + (k-1)ρ]\n")
cat("V_avg = (2.5)²/3 × [1 + 2(0.5)]\n")
cat("V_avg = 6.25/3 × 2\n")
cat("V_avg =", var_avg, "\n")
cat("SD_avg =", sd_avg, "\n\n")

# Effect size (Cohen's d) on averaged responses
cohens_d <- effect_size_raw / sd_avg

cat("=== Effect Size ===\n")
cat("Cohen's d (on averaged responses) = Δ / SD_avg\n")
cat("Cohen's d =", effect_size_raw, "/", round(sd_avg, 4), "=", round(cohens_d, 4), "\n\n")

# For a two-sample t-test (equivalent to between-group F-test)
# n_total = 2 * n_per_group (balanced design)
# SE(Δ) = sqrt(2 * V_avg / n_per_group)
# Under H1: t = Δ / SE(Δ) = sqrt(n_per_group * Δ² / (2 * V_avg))
# Power = P(t > t_crit | H1)

# Critical value for two-sided test at α=0.05
alpha_two_sided <- alpha / 2
z_crit <- qnorm(1 - alpha_two_sided)  # approximation for large df

cat("=== Test Statistics (Two-Sample t-test on Subject Averages) ===\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "(two-sided)\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("Z-critical (large df approximation):", round(z_crit, 4), "\n\n")

# Function to calculate power given n per group
calculate_power <- function(n_per_group) {
  df <- 2 * n_per_group - 2
  t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha_two_sided, df)
  
  # Non-centrality parameter: λ = sqrt(n_per_group / (2 * V_avg)) * Δ
  # Or equivalently: λ = sqrt(n_per_group * Δ² / (2 * V_avg))
  lambda <- sqrt(n_per_group * (effect_size_raw^2) / (2 * var_avg))
  
  # Power = P(t > t_crit | H1)
  power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = lambda)
  
  return(list(n = n_per_group, df = df, t_crit = t_crit, lambda = lambda, power = power))
}

# Search for minimum n achieving 80% power
# Start with a reasonable range
cat("=== Sample Size Determination ===\n")
cat("Searching for minimum n per group achieving 80% power...\n\n")

# Test a range of values
n_values <- seq(5, 30, by = 1)
results_df <- data.frame(
  n_per_group = n_values,
  df = NA,
  t_crit = NA,
  lambda = NA,
  power = NA
)

  results_df$t_crit[i] <- res$t_crit
  results_df$lambda[i] <- res$lambda
  results_df$power[i] <- res$power
}

cat("\n=== RESULTS ===\n")
cat("Minimum participants per group achieving 80% power:", n_min, "\n")
cat("Achieved power at n =", n_min, ":", round(results_df$power[min_n], 4), "\n")

if (n_min > 1) {

      round(results_df$power[results_df$n_per_group == n_min - 1], 4), "\n")
}

final_answer_power <- results_df$power[min_n]

cat("Total participants: ", 2 * final_answer_n, "\n")
cat("Participants per group: ", final_answer_n, "\n")
cat("Repeated measurements per participant: ", k, "\n")
cat("Total observations: ", 2 * final_answer_n * k, "\n")

  )
)

# Using a Monte Carlo simulation approach as an independent check

mu2 <- 49  # group 2 mean

alpha <- 0.05
n_per_group <- 18  # candidate answer

# Build compound symmetry covariance matrix
# Cov(Y_i, Y_j) = sigma^2 if i=j, sigma^2 * rho otherwise
Sigma_cs <- sigma^2 * (diag(k) * (1 - rho) + matrix(rho, k, k))

cat("=== Independent Verification via Simulation ===\n")
cat("Compound Symmetry Covariance Matrix:\n")
print(round(Sigma_cs, 4))
cat("\n")

n_sims <- 10000
sim_rejections <- 0
sim_test_stats <- numeric(n_sims)
sim_group1_avgs <- numeric(n_sims)
sim_group2_avgs <- numeric(n_sims)

for (sim in 1:n_sims) {
  # Generate data for group 1
  Y1 <- mvrnorm(n_per_group, mu = rep(mu1, k), Sigma = Sigma_cs)
  Y1_avg <- rowMeans(Y1)
  
  # Generate data for group 2
  Y2 <- mvrnorm(n_per_group, mu = rep(mu2, k), Sigma = Sigma_cs)
  Y2_avg <- rowMeans(Y2)
  
  # Two-sample t-test on averages
  t_stat <- t.test(Y1_avg, Y2_avg, var.equal = TRUE)$statistic
  p_val <- t.test(Y1_avg, Y2_avg, var.equal = TRUE)$p.value
  
  sim_test_stats[sim] <- t_stat
  sim_group1_avgs[sim] <- mean(Y1_avg)
  sim_group2_avgs[sim] <- mean(Y2_avg)

    sim_rejections <- sim_rejections + 1
  }

simulated_power_se <- sqrt(simulated_power * (1 - simulated_power) / n_sims)

# - Var(Xi) = sigma^2 for all i
# - Cov(Xi, Xj) = sigma^2 * rho for i ≠ j (compound symmetry)
# Then Var(mean(X)) = Var[(X1+X2+...+Xk)/k]
#                   = [1/k^2] * Var(X1+X2+...+Xk)
#                   = [1/k^2] * [k*sigma^2 + 2*sum_{i<j} sigma^2*rho]
#                   = [1/k^2] * [k*sigma^2 + 2*C(k,2)*sigma^2*rho]
#                   = [1/k^2] * [k*sigma^2 + k(k-1)*sigma^2*rho]
#                   = sigma^2/k * [1 + (k-1)*rho]

# Verification of test calibration and non-centrality parameter

library(MASS)

cat("=== Test Calibration and Non-Centrality Verification ===\n\n")

# Design parameters
k <- 3
rho <- 0.5
sigma <- 2.5
mu1 <- 51
mu2 <- 49
effect_raw <- 2
alpha <- 0.05
n_per_group <- 18

# Covariance structure
Sigma_cs <- sigma^2 * (diag(k) * (1 - rho) + matrix(rho, k, k))
var_avg <- (sigma^2 / k) * (1 + (k - 1) * rho)

cat("1. Test Calibration Under Null Hypothesis (H₀: μ₁ = μ₂)\n")
cat("   Generating data under null (both groups mean = 50)\n\n")

set.seed(54321)
n_sims_null <- 50000
rejections_null <- 0

for (sim in 1:n_sims_null) {
  Y1 <- mvrnorm(n_per_group, mu = rep(50, k), Sigma = Sigma_cs)
  Y2 <- mvrnorm(n_per_group, mu = rep(50, k), Sigma = Sigma_cs)
  Y1_avg <- rowMeans(Y1)
  Y2_avg <- rowMeans(Y2)
  
  t_test <- t.test(Y1_avg, Y2_avg, var.equal = TRUE)
  if (t_test$p.value < alpha) {
    rejections_null <- rejections_null + 1
  }
}

type_i_error <- rejections_null / n_sims_null
type_i_se <- sqrt(type_i_error * (1 - type_i_error) / n_sims_null)

cat("Simulated Type I error rate (n_sims =", n_sims_null, "):\n")
cat("α_empirical =", round(type_i_error, 4), " ± ", round(1.96*type_i_se, 4), "\n")
cat("Expected α = 0.0500\n")
cat("Discrepancy within ±1.96*SE?", abs(type_i_error - alpha) <= 1.96*type_i_se, "\n\n")

cat("2. Non-Centrality Parameter Verification\n\n")

# Analytical computation
df <- 2 * n_per_group - 2
se_diff <- sqrt(2 * var_avg / n_per_group)
t_stat_under_h1 <- effect_raw / se_diff

cat("Standard error of difference (under H1):\n")
cat("SE(Δ) = sqrt(2 * V_avg / n) = sqrt(2 * ", round(var_avg, 4), " / ", n_per_group, ")\n")
cat("      =", round(se_diff, 4), "\n\n")

cat("t-statistic under H1 (test of H₀: Δ = 0):\n")
cat("t = Δ / SE(Δ) =", round(effect_raw, 1), "/", round(se_diff, 4), 
    "=", round(t_stat_under_h1, 4), "\n\n")

cat("Non-centrality parameter (two sample t-test):\n")
cat("λ = t_stat = sqrt(n / (2*V_avg)) * Δ\n")
lambda_analytic <- sqrt(n_per_group / (2 * var_avg)) * effect_raw
cat("  = sqrt(", n_per_group, " / (2*", round(var_avg, 4), ")) *", effect_raw, "\n")
cat("  = sqrt(", round(n_per_group / (2 * var_avg), 4), ") *", effect_raw, "\n")
cat("  =", round(lambda_analytic, 4), "\n\n")

# Alternative formula
lambda_alt <- sqrt(n_per_group * effect_raw^2 / (2 * var_avg))
cat("Alternative: λ = sqrt(n * Δ² / (2*V_avg))\n")
cat("           =", round(lambda_alt, 4), "\n")
cat("Match?", abs(lambda_analytic - lambda_alt) < 1e-10, "\n\n")

cat("3. Verification of Power Computation\n\n")

alpha_two <- alpha / 2
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha_two, df)

cat("Degrees of freedom: df = 2n - 2 =", df, "\n")
cat("Critical t-value (α = 0.05, two-sided): t_crit = qt(0.975, df) =", round(t_crit, 4), "\n")
cat("Non-centrality parameter: λ =", round(lambda_analytic, 4), "\n\n")

cat("Power calculation:\n")
cat("Power = P(|t| > t_crit | H1)\n")
cat("      = P(t > t_crit | H1) + P(t < -t_crit | H1)\n")
cat("      = P(t_df,λ > t_crit) + P(t_df,λ < -t_crit)\n")
cat("      = [1 - F_t(t_crit; df, λ)] + F_t(-t_crit; df, λ)\n")
cat("      = [1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp=λ)] + pt(-t_crit, df, ncp=λ)\n\n")

power_upper_tail <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = lambda_analytic)
power_lower_tail <- pt(-t_crit, df, ncp = lambda_analytic)
total_power <- power_upper_tail + power_lower_tail

cat("Upper tail probability: 1 - F_t(", round(t_crit, 4), "; df=", df, ", λ=", 
    round(lambda_analytic, 4), ") =", round(power_upper_tail, 6), "\n")
cat("Lower tail probability: F_t(", round(-t_crit, 4), "; df=", df, ", λ=", 
    round(lambda_analytic, 4), ") =", round(power_lower_tail, 6), "\n")
cat("Total power: ", round(total_power, 6), "\n\n")

# This should equal what we computed before
cat("Candidate's reported power at n=18: 0.8147373\n")
cat("Current computation: ", round(total_power, 7), "\n")
cat("Match?", round(abs(total_power - 0.8147373401749086), 10) < 1e-10, "\n\n")

cat("4. Sanity Check: Effect Size (Cohen's d)\n\n")
sd_avg <- sqrt(var_avg)
cohens_d <- effect_raw / sd_avg
cat("Cohen's d = Δ / SD_avg = ", effect_raw, " / ", round(sd_avg, 4), 
    " = ", round(cohens_d, 4), "\n")
cat("Candidate's reported d: 0.9798\n")
cat("Match?", round(abs(cohens_d - 0.9797958971132712), 10) < 1e-10, "\n\n")

POWER_AGENT_RESULT_JSON <- paste0(
  "{\"results\":[",
  "{\"metric\":\"type_i_error_simulated\",\"value\":", round(type_i_error, 15), ",\"unit\":\"proportion\"},",
  "{\"metric\":\"type_i_error_se\",\"value\":", round(type_i_se, 15), ",\"unit\":\"proportion\"},",
  "{\"metric\":\"non_centrality_parameter\",\"value\":", round(lambda_analytic, 15), ",\"unit\":\"noncentrality\"},",
  "{\"metric\":\"power_computed\",\"value\":", round(total_power, 15), ",\"unit\":\"proportion\"},",
  "{\"metric\":\"power_candidate\",\"value\":0.8147373401749086,\"unit\":\"proportion\"}",
  "]}"
)

# Repeated-measures ANOVA for between-group main effect
# Design: 2 groups, 3 repeated measurements per participant
# Compound symmetry covariance structure

# Study parameters
k <- 3  # number of repeated measurements
rho <- 0.5  # compound symmetry correlation
sigma <- 2.5  # marginal SD (both groups)
mu1 <- 51  # group 1 mean
mu2 <- 49  # group 2 mean
effect_size_raw <- mu1 - mu2  # raw difference in group means
alpha <- 0.05  # significance level, two-sided
target_power <- 0.80
allocation_ratio <- 1  # balanced groups

# Calculate the variance of the subject-level average
# Under compound symmetry: V_avg = σ²/k × [1 + (k-1)ρ]
var_avg <- (sigma^2 / k) * (1 + (k - 1) * rho)
sd_avg <- sqrt(var_avg)

cat("=== Repeated-Measures ANOVA Design Parameters ===\n")
cat("Number of repeated measurements (k):", k, "\n")
cat("Compound symmetry correlation (ρ):", rho, "\n")
cat("Marginal SD (σ):", sigma, "\n")
cat("Group 1 mean:", mu1, "\n")
cat("Group 2 mean:", mu2, "\n")
cat("Raw effect (Δ = μ₁ - μ₂):", effect_size_raw, "\n\n")

cat("=== Effective Variance of Subject-Level Average ===\n")
cat("Formula: V_avg = σ²/k × [1 + (k-1)ρ]\n")
cat("V_avg = (2.5)²/3 × [1 + 2(0.5)]\n")
cat("V_avg = 6.25/3 × 2\n")
cat("V_avg =", var_avg, "\n")
cat("SD_avg =", sd_avg, "\n\n")

# Effect size (Cohen's d) on averaged responses
cohens_d <- effect_size_raw / sd_avg

cat("=== Effect Size ===\n")
cat("Cohen's d (on averaged responses) = Δ / SD_avg\n")
cat("Cohen's d =", effect_size_raw, "/", round(sd_avg, 4), "=", round(cohens_d, 4), "\n\n")

# For a two-sample t-test (equivalent to between-group F-test)
# n_total = 2 * n_per_group (balanced design)
# SE(Δ) = sqrt(2 * V_avg / n_per_group)
# Under H1: t = Δ / SE(Δ) = sqrt(n_per_group * Δ² / (2 * V_avg))
# Power = P(t > t_crit | H1)

# Critical value for two-sided test at α=0.05
alpha_two_sided <- alpha / 2
z_crit <- qnorm(1 - alpha_two_sided)  # approximation for large df

cat("=== Test Statistics (Two-Sample t-test on Subject Averages) ===\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "(two-sided)\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("Z-critical (large df approximation):", round(z_crit, 4), "\n\n")

# Function to calculate power given n per group
calculate_power <- function(n_per_group) {
  df <- 2 * n_per_group - 2
  t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha_two_sided, df)
  
  # Non-centrality parameter: λ = sqrt(n_per_group / (2 * V_avg)) * Δ

  lambda <- sqrt(n_per_group * (effect_size_raw^2) / (2 * var_avg))

  power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = lambda)
  
  return(list(n = n_per_group, df = df, t_crit = t_crit, lambda = lambda, power = power))
}

# Start with a reasonable range

cat("Searching for minimum n per group achieving 80% power...\n\n")
